collection.description: A nursery worker cannot tell why several toddlers become upset at the same point each afternoon.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (worker), a nursery worker, cannot tell why several toddlers become upset at the same point each afternoon.

choices.label: Ask Older Children What They Hear
Invite Children to Make a Gentle Routine

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They identify a startling echo from the nearby pounding stones.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They notice that the toddlers miss a familiar song that used to mark rest time.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) notices bright sunlight reaching the resting mats and suggests shade.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The older children recognize that one toddler is searching for a misplaced woven doll.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Their soft puppet story helps the toddlers settle.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The toddlers prefer quiet; the older children learn that helping sometimes means stepping away.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The children contribute an observation the adults had missed.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The cause remains uncertain, but the nursery changes one thing at a time to learn what helps.
